name: cost_per_guest_all_in
description: Works out the all-in wedding cost for each guest by sharing the total cost across the guests.
formula: all-in cost per guest = total_cost divided by guest_count, rounded to 2 decimals (halves round up). The guest count must be at least 1.

inputs.name: total_cost
inputs.description: Total wedding cost for this case, in your currency, including the dinner and all extras. Use the result of the total cost step.

inputs.name: guest_count
inputs.description: Whole number of guests for this same case. It must be at least 1.

output.description: The all-in cost per guest for this case, in your currency, rounded to 2 decimals.
